defective_pattern: Drafting narrative text without explicitly extracting and embedding the relevant primary statistical parameters (B, SE, beta, z, p-values) from the companion JSON payload.
why_defective: Failing to inject required test statistics into the text violates the academic writing standard that hypotheses results must explicitly report test statistics. This leads to validation failures.
observed_symptoms: Generation of .md and .docx deliverables that lack extracted statistical parameters like beta, p, and z.
Validation reports failing with missing statistical parameters in narrative text.
corrective_remedy: When drafting narrative deliverables from statistical JSON payloads, the agent MUST explicitly parse the 'primary_statistic' or structural path coefficients (B, SE, beta, z, p) from the JSON file and embed them directly into the running narrative.
